     MEMORANDUM FOR RECORD

      SUBJECT: Nairntive from Witness 1 - Western U.S . Event

     References: (a) https://www.war.gov/ufo/#Western-US-Event,VIRIN: 260508-D-D0360-1052,
                 08-MAY 2026.

      1. Executive Sumrna1y.

             本メモは、All-domain Anomaly Resolution Office (AARO) に提供された Witness 1 による一次的な叙述を示すものである。Witness 1 は、2023年10月に西部アメリカ合衆国で2日にわたり未確認異常現象（UAP）を観測したと報告した複数の米国連邦法執行機関特殊捜査官の一人である。

     2. Witness Na1rntive.

               AARO の、出来事の順序を彼らが正確に記憶しているとおりの自由形式の naiTative[na iTative] を提供するよう要請されたことへの応答として、Witness 1 は以下の文を提出した。

     "It staiied[staiied] the first night with other teains[teains] repo1iing[repo1iing] weird lights moving along in groups miles
     away. From my vantage point I could not see them, though in theo1y[theo1y] should have been able to.
     Because of my location I did not see anything specific the first night. The second night another
     teain[teain] member and I were out working and driving to our destination. As we headed through a
     valley area we suddenly noticed a large glowing ball to our right 90 degrees from where we
     were. It looked like it was between us and a hill face, and initially I guessed it was 500 to 600
     meters away, though another later day I was able to use a range finder to put the distance to the
     hillside at about 1100 meters. The ball appeared close to the hill face. It was just a circle of light
     that looked like a swirly pattern of bright lava. It was bright in the dusk light, the time was just
     before 7 pm I think. It was not visible up to the moment we first saw it, though the hillside face
     behind it was visible as we drove for some distance before we saw the object. The object's
     lighted ai·ea[ai·ea] was a well defined circle, but had no visible strncture[strncture] at the edges to show what
     contained the light or why it was where it was. Looking at it through binoculars it almost
     appeared to have a line or spindle below possibly touching the hillside below. It was not
     possible to verify for sure because of the distance. There was no observed glow behind or below
     the object on the hillside or ground. It was only observed for a minute or two before we could no
     longer see it. It did not fade out, we just could not see it anymore. There was no paii iculai·[paii iculai·]
     sound heai·d[heai·d] with it. All seemed quiet and it was pretty remote. I would have guessed the circle
     to be 20 feet or more in diameter. We sta1ied[sta1ied] driving and drove a few more minutes. Then we
     stopped and had to get out of the vehicle. About 20 minutes later to the front, another object that
     looked similar lit up in the sky over the top of another hillside slightly to the right of front. It
     appeai·ed[appeai·ed] to be several miles away. It only lit up for a second or two and then was gone again.

While it was lit, it appeared three red lights flew out of and away from it. They seemed evenly
spaced apart and moved pretty fast, quickly disappearing from sight. At the same time the
orange light lit up, there appeared to be a flash from over the horizon to the left. The flash lit up
the sky pretty well, though very briefly. About twenty minutes later the experience repeated
except this time the orange ball appeared to the front and slightly to the left this time. This time
however, the red lights appeared to leave in a different pattern as one flew straight out, one
appeared to fly up horizontally and another flew down horizontally, appearing to fly away in a
vertical alignment of three lights. A flash accompanied this event as well and all three sightings
appeared to be similar though at different distances. Several hours later we departed from where
we were at to drive to another location in preparation for work the next day.

It took several hours of driving, and as we were driving hours later still, we observed a car
driving ahead of us on the road, we were gaining on the car and as we got closer I noticed it
appeared one taillight cover was broken because one taillight was red and one was white. They
were also different because one was round and one was square. Another vehicle approached
from the opposite direction and as it was about to pass the vehicle in front of us, the car changed
direction and moved off the road to the right. The oncoming vehicle continued driving and
passed us, almost like it did not even see the vehicle move of the road as it passed. It did not
bounce or move with the terrain, but seemed to hover. It did not kick up any dust either. It
stopped on the road next to it, and the lights appeared to be in the same position facing us even
though we were in a different direction from it. When we stopped the lights turned off and I
could see a darker object moving up and toward behind us as it flew away. When we stopped we
already had the windows rolled down and I did not notice any sound at any point. It reminded
me of a Toyota Prius for some reason. It was hard to identify the exact shape though. The
hillside was about 200 meters away, and when it stopped it was less than halfway to the base of
the hillside. We started looking around the area and approximately an hour or two later as we
were stopped we observed some dust and thick spider web looking material floating in-front of
us. We then saw what looked like the same object floating in a more vertical orientation floating
with the dust. It was still at an off angle. I could see where the spots were for the two lights and
one being round and the other square. The lights were not on though. The object itself was still
hard to define its shape and borders visually. It was in the air about 15-20 feet up and as it
floated past I could see a star through the object, as well as the crest of the hill and some
vegetation. It was almost like looking at something through water where it was not completely
clear.

We eventually continued to our destination and I did not have any other contact or sightings of
those objects of that night that I observed.”




                                                                      Jon T. Kosloski
                                                                      Director, AARO

summaryJa: AARO作成のメモ（2026-06-02）に記載されたWitness 1の一次叙述。Witness 1は2023年10月の西部米国での2日間のUAP目撃を報告した連邦捜査官の一人。第1夜は他班の報告を聞いたが当人は特定の観測をできず、第2夜は同僚と車で谷間を走行中に右側の丘面付近に大きな発光する円形体を目撃（夕暮れ、直径約20フィート以上推定、当初距離推定500–600m、後の測定で丘面まで約1100m）。円は渦状で明るく、境界に構造は見えず、双眼鏡では下に線状の突起が見えるように見えたが確認不可。20分ごとに類似の発光が別の丘上で1–2秒点灯し、その際に3つの赤い光が飛び出し、左方地平から短い閃光があった。数時間後、道路上の車を追走中に先行車が道路外に移動して“ホバー”するように見え、ライトが同位置に残り消灯後に暗い物体が上方へ飛び去った。1–2時間後、停止中に塵や厚いクモの巣状物質とともに同様の物体が高さ約15–20フィートで斜めに漂い、透けて星や丘の稜線、植生が見えた。目的地到着までに再接触はなかった。
summaryEn: Memo to record (02 June 2026) contains Witness 1’s first‑hand account to AARO. Witness 1, a U.S. federal law enforcement special agent, reported observing UAP over two days in October 2023 in the western U.S. On night one they heard other teams’ reports but did not see anything specific. On night two, while driving through a valley with a team member, they observed a large glowing circular object near a hillside to their right at dusk (estimated diameter ~20+ ft; initially estimated 500–600 m away, later range finding placed the hillside ~1,100 m away). The circle showed a swirly, lava‑like bright pattern, no visible edge structure, and through binoculars appeared to have a line or spindle below possibly touching the hillside (not confirmed). About 20 minutes later similar brief (~1–2 s) lights appeared over another hillside; three red lights flew out from one of them and a brief flash occurred over the left horizon. The pattern repeated ~20 minutes later with different trajectories of the three red lights and another flash. Several hours later while driving they observed a nearby vehicle move off the road and appear to hover; its lights stayed oriented toward the witness, then turned off and a darker object was seen moving up and away. One to two hours later, while stopped, they observed dust and thick spider‑web‑like material and then what looked like the same object floating at about 15–20 ft high, semi‑transparent (a star and hill crest visible through it). No further contacts or sightings occurred that night.
